Set \(\frac{3k-9}{2}=0 \Rightarrow k=3\).  
The constant term is
\[
\binom{9}{3}2^{6}(-1)^3=84\cdot 64\cdot(-1)=-5376.
\]
The sum of all coefficients is found by letting \(x=1\):
\[
\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt1}-1\right)^9=(2-1)^9=1.
\]
Thus the sum of nonconstant coefficients is
\[
1-(-5376)=5377.
\]
\[
\boxed{5377}
\]
